title: Neutrinos from Deep Inside Earth Provide a New Picture of the Mantle
summary: Scientists are using geoneutrinos—subatomic particles produced by radioactive decay deep within Earth—to study the composition and structure of the planet's mantle, providing a new window into geological processes that cannot be directly observed through drilling.
problem_solved: Revealing the chemical composition and heat sources in Earth's deep mantle that are inaccessible through direct sampling.
why_valuable: Offers a non-invasive method to understand Earth's internal structure and the radioactive elements driving geological activity, which could reshape our understanding of plate tectonics and planetary formation.
